candidate.workingTreeState: The compiled snapshot included uncommitted worktree edits; this is validation evidence, not the final release candidate.

summary.scope: Original-scope UI acceptance plus local candidate test suite; packaged release gate is outside this result.

items.result: Standard palette colors and custom HEX applied to the intended block and persisted.
Quick filters returned expected rows and reset correctly; two simultaneous filters and controls fit at 800x600.
Image menu, caption, three alignments, recrop of an existing crop, canceled replacement, applied replacement, persistence, and original synthetic source integrity verified.
Full width and page menus fit wide and narrow viewports; nested icon dialog layers above settings, Escape closes the top layer and restores focus.
Opt-in hierarchical collapse, disable/restore behavior, and reopen persistence verified.
Keyboard focus/edit/commit, clipboard, vertical and horizontal fill, preservation of other cells, and undo verified.
Portuguese Editar coluna action opened the intended settings.
Conditional palette/custom HEX and Valor >= 200 formula colored only matching rows after reopen.
Linked view collapse/expand and title hiding persisted without renderer errors while source access remained available.

Compact options and active filter/sort state verified. The current snapshot directly verified the Options > Properties path for a trashed database: Protected field visible, five mutation controls disabled, row mutation controls absent, and Markdown unchanged.
Canonical inline embed and linked view matched table/header/cell styles under identical source, view configuration, viewport, and width; independent rename persisted.
Per-view calculations persisted; body/footer alignment held under default and explicit alignment, resize, horizontal scroll, and frozen columns.
Actual drag into a six-column group showed an indicator, moved content into column seven, persisted, and rejected column eight.
Mouse/keyboard range selection, Delete, Backspace, row preservation, and undo verified.
Grip click selected a row, right-click opened row actions, and filtered/multi-row/keyboard selection plus insert/undo/duplicate/trash/recovery flows passed.
All 25 property types had icons and localized name/alias search worked.
Formula relation tokens, suggestions, keyboard insertion, and persisted binding verified.
Applicable formula result formatting matched Number controls; zero and false remained distinct from empty.
New inverse creation and populated existing-relation linking/merge persisted; candidate suite passed.
Raster/SVG property icons rendered at 14px in header and settings slots, persisted across supported changes/reopen, and preserved page icon.

limitations: No win-unpacked executable or installer was launched; packaged smoke is not covered by this matrix.
Final Windows packaging, NSIS payload inspection, signing, artifact hashes, CI on publication commit, and publication remain pending.

The aggregate full-page-source versus linked-view comparison for item 11 was not verified because it is not the canonical inline-embed comparison; the focused canonical inline-versus-linked comparison passed.
The compiled UI snapshot included uncommitted worktree edits according to the run report; repeat validation on the final integrated release build.
auditNotes: delivery5-ui-2026-10-28T17-17-10-052Z-38064.json records maxPropertyGuardIncludedInTestedBuild=false, but the harness reads this opt-in field from MORROW_DELIVERY5_PROPERTY_LIMIT_GUARD_BUILT and defaults it to false; it is metadata, not an app assertion and is not used to score item 19. Candidate source contains the 200-property guard, and delivery3.test.ts covers cardinality conflict, limit, invalid ID, and duplicate ID without partial relation changes. npm run check passed.
